notes.en:
## New Features

- Select message, tool-output or file text to create temporary reference chips; press Alt+Q to keep them in the draft, and click a reference to return to and highlight its source selection. Sent user messages retain references as compact chips.
- Browse commit changes in a directory tree with switchable side-by-side diffs, collapsible descriptions and metadata, contextual highlighting and automatic scrolling to the selected file.
- Import Claude Code and Codex sessions from uploaded files, server directories or authorized remote devices, and export narrator sessions for continued work in those CLIs. Preserve supported subagents, images and compact history with bounded import/export resource usage.
- Synchronize workspace layouts across devices in real time, and remove associated panels when a narrator is closed from the sidebar.
- Reorder Spec outline tabs by dragging and pin them from the context menu; serialize layout saves to prevent older requests from overwriting the new order.
- Choose a Git commit identity when creating a session, with a personal display preference for the identity controls.
- Add a dedicated Stop tool for tracked background tasks and subagents, preserving ownership checks and OAuth cancellation boundaries.

## Improvements

- Unify input, output and cache-token accounting across provider paths, display cache-hit rates, and provide compact usage-history reconciliation without double counting or reconciliation races.
- Separate authoritative GitHub publication from optional update-server mirroring, and improve production WebDAV relay compatibility and asset-identity validation.
- Speed up narrator opening with parallel first-screen loading, bounded database workers, versioned history caches and shared in-flight requests; fix visible, unfocused workspace panels remaining on message skeletons.
- Give auxiliary components an independent release lifecycle. New application versions pin and reuse the published executor 0.9.1 instead of requiring a new executor release; verify actual component build inputs before reuse without treating a Bun control-runtime upgrade as a Go executor change.
- Improve mobile terminal-management layouts and keep update actions visible beside long build commit identifiers.
- Show hidden files by default in the narrator file tree, provide a visibility toggle, and exclude the .git directory.
- Avoid repeatedly scanning full rollback plans when updating journal receipts; improve cleanup and timing-sensitive regression coverage.
- Update the build and CI runtime to Bun 1.4.3.

## Fixes

- Serialize chapter worktree registration changes per repository so concurrent forks cannot observe partially initialized worktree metadata.
- Fix tens-of-seconds server stalls caused by model-catalog protection statistics repeatedly validating the complete catalog for every binding; reuse batch resolvers and invalidate protection-count caches correctly.
- Normalize saved context-window settings automatically and load the model catalog correctly on cold start.
- Allow plan-mode narrators to receive delegated results and use consistent continuation admission; fix model-history worker candidate probing.
- Prevent native text dragging from locking message selection or the page, without blocking unrelated drag interactions.
- Restore workspace switching when the working directory has disappeared, using cached repository identity without weakening permission checks; fix Git-panel permission and scope regressions.
- Fix image-viewer menus and clipboard copying, retaining selection/download fallbacks in insecure contexts or when permission is denied; selection-copy fallback only accepts data:image content.
- Advance binary request-recording offsets before transferred buffers are detached, preventing recording corruption.
- Prevent nested model-timeout retries from multiplying the retry budget. Preserve configured Anthropic endpoints on connection resets and unify provider-readiness checks for combined configuration schemas.
- Prevent Telegram's request-promise dependency from clearing Bun's module registry and reloading server singletons.
- Protect installed database migrations against unsafe replay, reject late worker results, fix PostgreSQL migration schema paths on Windows, and correctly release user/project resources and cached archives during deletion.
- Keep persistence errors focused on the underlying driver cause; return actionable disk-safety hints while logging probe-failure details separately.
- Pass complete KnowledgeCreate arguments to approval and retain rejection reasons; distinguish KnowledgeRead server failures from missing or inaccessible entries.
- Correct copied ShareFile links, plugin-panel host identity validation, sortable drag constraints and release-upload diagnostics.

## Notes

- This version follows the default beta/prerelease channel rule.
- Reuses executor-v0.9.1 and helpers-v1.0.0; unchanged auxiliary components are not republished.
- Imported/exported sessions and request recordings may contain conversation and file contents; inspect them before sharing.
- Native smoke does not imply macOS notarization, Windows Authenticode signing or validation on older CPUs without AVX2.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 选中消息、工具输出或文件文本后可生成临时引用 chip，按 Alt+Q 固化到草稿；点击引用返回并高亮原始选区，已发送的用户消息保留紧凑引用展示。
- 提交预览支持目录树与可切换的分栏 diff，可折叠说明和元数据，提供上下文高亮与选中文件自动滚动。
- 支持从上传文件、本服务器目录或有权限的远程设备导入 Claude Code / Codex 会话，也可将叙述者会话导出到这些 CLI 继续工作；保留支持的子代理、图片与 compact 历史，并限制导入导出的资源占用。
- 工作区布局支持跨设备实时同步；在侧边栏关闭叙述者时，关联面板一并移除。
- Spec 大纲标签支持拖拽排序与右键置顶，串行保存排布，避免旧请求覆盖新顺序。
- 新建会话时可选择 Git 提交身份，身份控件的显示由个人偏好控制。
- 新增独立 Stop 工具，用于取消已跟踪的后台任务和子代理，保留资源归属校验与 OAuth 取消权限边界。

## 改进

- 统一各供应商的输入、输出和缓存 token 统计，展示缓存命中率，提供精简的历史用量核对，避免重复计数和核对竞态。
- 解耦 GitHub 权威发布与可选更新服务器镜像，完善生产环境 WebDAV 中转兼容性及资产身份校验。
- 通过首屏并行加载、有界数据库 worker、版本化历史缓存及请求聚合加快叙述者打开速度；修复工作区内可见但未获焦面板持续停留在消息骨架屏的问题。
- 附加组件采用独立发布周期：新主程序固定并复用已发布的 executor 0.9.1，不再要求每个主程序版本重发执行器；复用前校验实际组件构建输入，Bun 控制运行时升级不再被误判为 Go 执行器变化。
- 改善终端管理页的移动端窄屏布局，避免长构建提交号挤出更新提示的操作按钮。
- 叙述者文件树默认显示隐藏文件，提供显示开关，并排除 .git 目录。
- 回退 receipt 更新不再反复全量扫描执行计划，完善清理流程与时序敏感回归覆盖。
- 构建与 CI 运行时升级到 Bun 1.4.3。

## 修复

- 按仓库串行修改章节的 Git worktree 注册信息，避免并发分叉读取尚未初始化完成的工作树元数据。
- 修复模型目录保护字段统计对每条绑定反复校验整份目录、造成服务端主线程卡顿几十秒的问题，复用批量解析器并完善计数缓存失效。
- 自动规范化已保存的上下文窗口设置，修复冷启动模型目录加载。
- 允许计划模式叙述者接收委派结果并统一续跑准入，修复模型历史 worker 的候选模块探测。
- 避免消息文本原生拖放导致选区或页面锁死，同时保留无关拖动交互。
- 工作目录丢失后，可基于缓存的仓库身份恢复工作区切换，同时保留权限校验；修复 Git 面板的权限与作用域回归。
- 修复图片查看器菜单和剪贴板复制，在非安全上下文或权限被拒时保留选区复制及下载降级；选区复制降级只接受 data:image 内容。
- 在录制二进制请求块的 buffer 转移前推进偏移，避免记录损坏。
- 避免模型超时在内外层叠加重试预算；Anthropic 连接重置时保留配置端点，统一组合配置 schema 的供应商就绪判断。
- 阻止 Telegram 的 request-promise 依赖清空 Bun 模块注册表，避免服务端单例被重复加载。
- 保护已安装的数据库迁移，避免不安全的重放；拒绝 worker 迟到结果；修复 Windows 上 PostgreSQL 迁移 schema 路径，以及删除用户、项目时的资源释放和归档缓存清理。
- 持久化错误明确展示底层驱动原因；磁盘安全提示只保留可行动信息，探测失败详情单独写入日志。
- KnowledgeCreate 审批传入完整参数并保留拒绝原因；KnowledgeRead 区分服务端故障与条目不存在或无权访问。
- 修正 ShareFile 复制链接、插件面板宿主身份校验、sortable 拖动约束及发布上传诊断。

## 说明

- 本版本按默认规则发布到 beta / prerelease 通道。
- 复用 executor-v0.9.1 与 helpers-v1.0.0，不重复发布未变化的附加组件。
- 导入导出的会话及请求录制可能包含对话与文件内容，分享前请检查。
- 原生 smoke 不代表 macOS 公证、Windows Authenticode 签名或旧款无 AVX2 CPU 验证。
